wiki.title: Jeffrey Wiley
wiki.extract: Jeffrey Wiley is an American politician serving as a member of the Louisiana House of Representatives from the 81st district. A member of the Republican Party, Wiley representing parts of Ascension Parish, Livingston Parish, and St. James Parish, and has been in office since January 8, 2024. Wiley was the Ascension Parish Sheriff from 1996 to 2019.
